text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Thank you for everything up until today, 
beach hut owner. No—my irreplaceable 
worthy rival.

text_block_list.name: Beach Hut Owner
text_block_list.text:
Right back at you, Light O. Thanks to you, 
I was able to level up too. I appreciate 
it.

One day, toward the end of summer training 
camp, Calstone Light O and a beach shack 
owner were shaking hands.
choice_data_list:
A friendship blossomed?! When did that 
happen?!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Y-Yes... As fellow ramen-servers in the 
summer, it seems they really hit it off...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
A friendship forged over ramen... Isn't 
that wonderful? Ehehe~♪
